These campaigns utilize social media ads, messaging platforms, and sophisticated infrastructure, including domain rotation and lookalike sites, to evade detection and exploit consumer interest in events like the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Source Title: Fake shops target shoppers across Europe with fake Samsung deals, counterfeit goods and World Cup scams

Original Article Title: Payouts King Ransomware Initial Access Broker Deploys New Edgecution Malware
Summary: Threat actors associated with Payouts King ransomware are deploying a malicious Microsoft Edge extension called Edgecution to establish a foothold in victim environments. The malware exploits the Chrome native messaging protocol to bypass browser sandboxing, allowing it to execute arbitrary code and interact with the host filesystem via a Python-based backdoor.
Source Title: Payouts King Ransomware Initial Access Broker Deploys New Edgecution Malware

Original Article Title: Browser-Only Ransomware: From LLM Hallucinations to a Practical Attack Technique

This attack path allows web pages to read and modify sensitive user files, such as photo directories, without requiring native payloads or browser exploits.

Original Article Title: Beware of the license manager: how a Schneider Electric software vulnerability puts industrial facilities at risk
